edges.reason: Constructor derives initial ownership and initial supply from msg.sender, an untrusted caller.
owner() returns _owner which was initialized from msg.sender.
transfer uses _msgSender() as the sender of the transfer.
approve uses _msgSender() as the allowance owner.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as the spender and allowance holder.
msg.sender flows into the from parameter of _transfer via transfer().
manualswap authorizes msg.sender against privileged development/marketing addresses.
manualsend authorizes msg.sender against privileged development/marketing addresses.
block.timestamp is used directly as the swap deadline causing timestamp dependency.
Timestamp-derived deadline is passed into the external Uniswap swap call.
swapTokensForEth executes an external router call that can run pair/token callbacks.
swapTokensForEth grants router allowance before swapping.
_transfer invokes swapTokensForEth during token movement, enabling reentrant swap paths.
_transfer forwards the contract ETH balance to the fee receiver after swapping.
sendETHToFee pushes ETH through the low-level transfer to the marketing address.
_transfer delegates the final accounting to _tokenTransfer.
_tokenTransfer performs the standard reflection transfer.
_tokenTransfer removes fees when takeFee is false.
_tokenTransfer restores fees after the transfer.
_transferStandard fetches computed amounts from _getValues.
_transferStandard credits the team allocation.
_transferStandard reflects the fee.
_takeTeam needs the current reflection rate.
_getValues derives token values via _getTValues.
_getValues derives reflection values via _getRValues.
_getRValues relies on the reflection rate computation.
_getRate obtains supplies from _getCurrentSupply.
transfer calls _transfer.
transferFrom calls _transfer.
transferFrom decreases the allowance via _approve.
approve sets the allowance via _approve.
balanceOf converts reflections with tokenFromReflection.
_transfer queries balances to enforce wallet limits and swap thresholds.
manualswap lets a privileged caller force a swap at an arbitrary moment.
manualsend lets a privileged caller force ETH distribution to the marketing address.
Constructor writes the Uniswap router address.
Constructor writes the Uniswap pair address.
Constructor creates the Uniswap pair through an external factory call.
Constructor assigns the total reflection supply to msg.sender.

Constructor marks owner, contract and fee addresses as fee-excluded.

setFee writes the sell redistribution fee.
setFee writes the sell tax fee.

setMaxWalletSize writes the maximum wallet size.
toggleSwap writes the swapEnabled flag.
setMinSwapTokensThreshold writes the swap threshold.
excludeMultipleAccountsFromFees updates the fee exclusion mapping.
_transfer reads _maxTxAmount to enforce the transaction limit.
_transfer reads _maxWalletSize to enforce wallet limits.
_transfer reads tradingOpen to gate transfers before trading starts.
_transfer reads the bots blacklist to block addresses.
_transfer uses uniswapV2Pair to detect buys and sells.
_transfer checks fee exclusions to decide whether to take fees.
_transfer compares balance against _swapTokensAtAmount to trigger swaps.
_transfer sets _redisFee for the current trade direction.
_transfer sets _taxFee for the current trade direction.
renounceOwnership overwrites the owner storage variable.
transferOwnership overwrites the owner storage variable.
_approve writes the nested allowances mapping.
_reflectFee decreases the total reflection supply.
_takeTeam increases the contract reflected balance.
_transferStandard updates sender and recipient reflected balances.
removeAllFee saves and zeroes _redisFee.
restoreAllFee restores _redisFee from the saved value.
removeAllFee saves and zeroes _taxFee.
restoreAllFee restores _taxFee from the saved value.
manualswap authorization compares msg.sender with the development address.
manualswap authorization compares msg.sender with the marketing address.
manualsend authorization compares msg.sender with the development address.
manualsend authorization compares msg.sender with the marketing address.
ETH fees are routed to the marketing payable address during sensitive swap state changes.
The router state variable supplies the target of the external swap call.
The external Uniswap swap can re-enter token transfer logic while swap state is mid-update.
ETH push to the fee address can invoke a fallback that re-enters transfer logic.
The from parameter feeds the transfer entry checks.
The to parameter feeds the recipient and pair checks.
The amount parameter feeds the limit checks and fee math.
The newOwner parameter is written to the owner storage.
The tokenAmount parameter feeds the router swap call.
The amount parameter feeds the marketing ETH transfer.
The _tradingOpen parameter is written to the trading flag.
The maxTxAmount parameter is written to the transaction limit.
The maxWalletSize parameter is written to the wallet limit.
The redisFeeOnBuy parameter is written to the buy fee configuration.
The contract token balance local drives swap triggering in _transfer.
The takeFee local decides fee handling in _transfer.
The path local is built for the router swap call.
The cached rate local is returned by _getRate.

normalization_plan.reason: The from parameter only carries the sender into _transfer and has no independent security semantics.
The to parameter only selects the recipient and pair checks inside _transfer.
The amount parameter is consumed solely by the transfer limit and fee math of _transfer.
The newOwner parameter is a direct input to the ownership update in transferOwnership.
The tokenAmount parameter is the only input to the router swap call in swapTokensForEth.
The amount parameter is passed directly to the marketing ETH transfer in sendETHToFee.
The boolean parameter is written straight into the tradingOpen state variable.
The parameter is written directly into the _maxTxAmount state variable.
The parameter is written directly into the _maxWalletSize state variable.
The parameter is assigned to the _redisFeeOnBuy configuration inside setFee.
The local balance is computed and used exclusively for swap decisions in _transfer.
The local boolean is derived and consumed only inside _transfer to control fees.
The path array is constructed only for the router swap call in swapTokensForEth.
The cached rate local is produced and returned solely by the _getRate function.
